company.name: Paid
company.shortDescription: Paid is a modern billing automation platform for small and large businesses.
company.description:
Paid is your company’s invoicing on autopilot. Paid replaces the need for businesses to dedicate engineering resources or hire employees to build their own accounts receivable management. 

Paid’s API translates your customer data into beautiful, custom-branded invoices and manages the payment entire process from reminders to reconciliation. Paid’s integration gives you the power to easily accept payment via credit card, PayPal, ACH and wire transfers directly through invoices. They even collect and deposit your checks. 

Simply put, Paid is the easiest way to get paid. Paid makes magic of the entire process, all while bringing full cash flow transparency. Get started today for free at paidapi.com.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,529,571 to $8,527,910, a 5.58x increase.
